label: General allometry: measured exponents compose (W = a L^b)
statement_en: For power laws f L = a L^b with real exponents: the ratio between two sizes is (L2/L1)^b, the log-log exponent is b, a quotient of power laws is a power law with exponent b1 − b2 (so wing loading W/S has exponent bW − bS), the cube law is the case b = 3, and under power laws for weight and lifting area with constant ρ and C_L,max the minimum-speed exponent is (bW − bS)/2.

hypotheses.name: flight-allometry-law#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: That weight and area follow single power laws over the size range in question with the exponents committed; the fitted exponents are separate regressions with their own errors.

hypotheses.name: flight-allometry-law#assumed-2
hypotheses.statement: Nothing measured for Exocoetidae enters a statement; the exponents are candidate inputs.

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: it applies wherever the design supplies the quantities it uses and accepts the hypotheses in scope.assumed
kernelChecked: PowerLaw f a b ⇒ f(L2)/f(L1) = (L2/L1)^b and log exponent b (powerLaw_ratio, powerLaw_log).
Quotients: PowerLaw (f/g) (a1/a2) (b1 − b2) (powerLaw_div); CubeLaw is PowerLaw with b = 3 (cubeLaw_powerLaw).
Under PowerLaw W and PowerLaw S with constant ρ, C_L,max: the v_min log exponent is (bW − bS)/2 (vmin_powerLaw_log).
